dedupe_keys.name: forced vibration tests of a reinforced concrete four story building structure

description: Forced-vibration tests of a reinforced-concrete, four-story building structure is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Jesús Valdés-González, Autonomous University of Mexico State (uaemex.mx). A set of acceleration records obtained at specific points of an actual reinforced concrete, four-story building structure subjected to forced vibrations are presented and documented in this project. The structure has vertical setbacks so that it has natural eccentricity along one direction. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Building torsion, forced vibration tests, full-scale concrete building, mechanical eccentric-mass exciter. Published 2020-02-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
